summary.name: Motrix
summary.one_liner: Motrix is a full-featured download manager that handles HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet link downloads in one interface.
use_cases: downloading files over HTTP or FTP
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Motrix as a full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and Magnet downloads. It states that files, torrents, and plugins are handled in one interface. The page announces a 2.0 version, but gives few technical details. Listings on awesome-mac pages describe it as open-source and freeware.
notable: Open-source since 2018 (per awesome-mac listing, source on GitHub)
Single interface for files, torrents, and plugins
caveats: Page does not name platforms explicitly; macOS is inferred from the awesome-mac listings only
Few technical details or limits are given on the page
